feature_intro.title: Rewrite one paragraph, five directions
feature_intro.description: A paragraph rewriter that works on the passage you paste — pick a single editing goal, get two rewrite options, and see exactly what changed before anything reaches your clipboard.

items.title: One goal at a time
items.description: Choose clearer, shorter, more formal, more natural, or restructure — the rewriter concentrates on that single edit instead of changing everything at once.

items.title: Two options to compare
items.description: Every run produces two rewrite options side by side, so you can keep the wording you prefer instead of accepting a single take.

items.title: Changes you can see
items.description: Wording that changed is highlighted in the selected rewrite, and your original text stays on screen for a line-by-line check.

how_to_use.title: How to rewrite a paragraph with AI
how_to_use.description: From a pasted passage to a reviewed rewrite in four steps.

items.title: Paste your paragraph
items.description: Paste one paragraph or a short passage into the paragraph rewriter. Your text stays in the form and is never saved.

items.title: Choose one rewrite goal
items.description: Pick clearer, shorter, more formal, more natural, or restructure, and add optional requirements.

items.title: Compare two rewrite options
items.description: Read Option A and Option B side by side and select the version that fits your context.

items.title: Review changes and copy
items.description: Check the highlighted wording against the original, verify facts and citations, then copy the selected rewrite.

feature_benefits.title: Why writers use it
feature_benefits.description: A focused AI paragraph rewriter — one goal, two candidates, and every change visible.

items.title: A focused editing goal
items.description: Naming one goal per run keeps the rewrite surgical — your argument, examples, and voice stay in place.

items.title: Two reviewable alternatives
items.description: Comparing two options takes seconds and often surfaces better phrasing than a single answer would.

items.title: Reminders to protect your facts
items.description: Changed wording is highlighted and you are reminded to review facts, quotations, and citations before using the result.

feature_section.title: What you can rewrite

items.title: Academic paragraphs

faq_section.title: Paragraph Rewriter FAQ
faq_section.description: How the tool works, what it does with your text, and what to expect from the results.

items.title: Why do I get two rewrite options?
items.description: Each run produces Option A and Option B — two different takes on the same goal. Reading them side by side makes it easy to choose the wording that fits your context, or to run another pass if neither is quite right.

items.title: What do the rewrite goals do?
items.description: You pick one goal per run: Clearer simplifies confusing wording, Shorter trims length, More formal raises the register, More natural relaxes stiff phrasing, and Restructure reorders the flow of the paragraph. One goal at a time keeps the edit focused.

items.title: Which language is the rewrite in?
items.description: By default the rewrite follows the language of your pasted paragraph: an English paragraph stays English, a German paragraph stays German. You can also pick a fixed output language from the dropdown if you want the result in another language.

items.title: Is my paragraph private?
items.description: Yes. The paragraph rewriter sends your pasted text to generate the rewrites and does not save it to your account or our database. Only anonymous usage counts are recorded — never your text or the generated result.

items.title: Will it keep facts, quotations, and citations intact?
items.description: The rewriter is instructed to preserve factual content, quotations, and citations while rewording, but rephrasing can still introduce errors. Highlighted changes mark where wording moved — always review them against your original before using the result.

items.title: How is this different from Essay Extender?
items.description: The paragraph rewriter works on a passage you already have, reshaping it toward one editing goal. Essay Extender grows a draft toward a target word count, adding depth and examples. Use the rewriter to fix wording, and Essay Extender when you need more length.

items.title: Can it rewrite my paragraph sentence by sentence?
items.description: Yes. Paste a single sentence or a full passage — the AI rewriter works at whatever length you bring, and the diff review shows exactly which words and sentences changed.

cta_section.title: Polish the paragraph, then keep writing
cta_section.description: Once your paragraph reads the way you want, open AI Write to draft the sections around it — with Story Bible and Consistency Check available inside the editor.
